scientific_integrity: Analytical proof via Schur complement and exact inequalities; finite independent matrix comparisons support it but do not imply an infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted clique corona with private leaf per core, at least three core vertices, and perfect noise-free grounding; no general weighted or arbitrary-core theorem. Equivalent less-indexed literature remains possible.
title: Exact all-budget noise-free leader selection on clique coronas
